+    description: List of logging settings to manage together.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+    suboptions:
+      dest:
+        type: str
+        choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on]
+      name:
+        type: str
+      udp_port:
+        type: int
+      facility:
+        type: str
+      level:
+        type: str
+        choices: [alerts, critical, debugging, emergencies, errors, informational, notifications, warnings]
+      state:
+        type: str
+        choices: [present, absent]
+  state:
+    description: Whether the selected logging setting should exist.
+    type: str
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare desired settings with the running configuration.
+    type: bool
+    default: true

+- name: Configure IPv6 syslog and a facility

+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: host, name: '2001:db8::1', udp_port: 514}
+      - {facility: local0}

+  returned: always

+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    if param is None:

+

+
+

+    for entry in lst:
+        if entry.get('name') == name:
+            return entry
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want) - set(have), set(have) - set(want)
+
+

+

+

+

+            entry['name'] = None

+    facility = 'user'
+    facility_explicit = False

+            facility = 'user'
+            facility_explicit = False

+    command = 'logging host '

+    if entry.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port %s' % entry['udp_port']
+    return command
+

+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for entry in want:
+        state = entry['state']
+        dest = entry['dest']
+        facility = entry.get('facility')
+        if facility is not None:
+            current = next((item for item in have if item['dest'] is None), None)
+            current_facility = current.get('facility') if current else 'user'
+            explicit = current.get('facility_explicit', False) if current else False
+            if state == 'present' and facility != current_facility:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % facility)
+            elif state == 'absent' and facility == current_facility and explicit:
+                commands.append('no logging facility')

+            continue

+            same = [item for item in have if item['dest'] == 'host' and
+                    item['name'] == entry['name'] and item.get('addr6') == entry['addr6']]

+                found = search_obj_in_list(entry['name'], same)
+                exact = same if state == 'absent' else ([found] if found else [])
+            else:
+                exact = [item for item in same if item.get('udp_port') == entry['udp_port']]

+                commands.extend('no ' + _host_command(item) for item in exact)
+            elif not exact:
+                commands.extend('no ' + _host_command(item) for item in same)
+                commands.append(_host_command(entry))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = next((item for item in have if item['dest'] == 'buffered'), None)
+            active = current.get('level', set()) if current else set()
+            levels = entry['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, active)
+                commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in LEVELS if level in adds)
+            else:
+                _, removes = diff_in_list(active - levels, active)
+                commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in LEVELS if level in removes)
+        else:
+            exists = any(item['dest'] == dest for item in have)
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging %s' % dest
+            if state == 'present' and not exists:
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent' and exists:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(commands))
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTS),
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=LEVELS),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'], default='present'),
+    )

+    remove_default_spec(aggregate_spec)
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                                   fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    required_if = [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, required_if)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import patch
+from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
+from ansible.modules.network.icx import icx_logging
+from .icx_module import TestICXModule
+
+
+class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
+    module = icx_logging
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.config_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
+        self.config = self.config_patch.start()
+        self.config.return_value = ''
+        self.load_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')
+        self.load = self.load_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_ipv4_ipv6_and_facility(self):
+        self.config.return_value = 'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514\nlogging facility local1'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=514),
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=1514),
+            dict(facility='local0'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', state='absent')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
+            'logging facility local0',
+            'no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514'])
+
+    def test_host_port_change_and_idempotency(self):
+        self.config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=1514))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
+            'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514',
+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514'])
+        self.config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514'
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_buffered_levels_and_global_toggles(self):
+        self.config.return_value = '\n'.join([
+            'logging buffered', 'no logging buffered debugging',
+            'logging console', 'logging enable rfc5424'])
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='alerts', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='console', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='rfc5424', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='on', state='absent')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
+            'logging buffered debugging', 'no logging buffered alerts',
+            'no logging console', 'no logging enable rfc5424', 'no logging on'])
+
+    def test_facility_clear_and_repeat(self):
+        self.config.return_value = 'logging facility local0'
+        set_module_args(dict(facility='local0', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging facility'])
+        self.config.return_value = 'no logging facility'
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_required_fields(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='buffered')]))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:bad::not-ipv6'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+
+    def test_check_mode(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', _ansible_check_mode=True))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1'])
+        self.load.assert_not_called()

+                               udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'),
+                               addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split()[2]
+            facility_explicit = True
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+            facility_explicit = False
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = set(LEVELS)
+            buffered_seen = True
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered.add(level)
+                buffered_seen = True
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            buffered.discard(line.split()[3])
+            buffered_seen = True
+        elif line in ('logging console', 'logging persistence', 'logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[1]
+            result.append(dict(dest=dest, name=None, udp_port=None, addr6=False))
+        elif line in ('no logging console', 'no logging persistence', 'no logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'no logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[2]
+            result[:] = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != dest]
+    if buffered_seen:
+        result.append(dict(dest='buffered', level=buffered, name=None, udp_port=None, addr6=False))
+    result.append(dict(dest=None, facility=facility, facility_explicit=facility_explicit,
+                       name=None, udp_port=None, addr6=False))
+    if on:
+        result.append(dict(dest='on', name=None, udp_port=None, addr6=False))
+    return result
+
+
+def _host_command(entry):
+    command = 'logging host '
+    if entry.get('addr6'):
+        command += 'ipv6 '
+    command += entry['name']
+    if entry.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port %s' % entry['udp_port']
+    return command
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for entry in want:
+        state = entry['state']
+        dest = entry['dest']
+        facility = entry.get('facility')
+        if facility is not None:
+            current = next((item for item in have if item['dest'] is None), None)
+            current_facility = current.get('facility') if current else 'user'
+            explicit = current.get('facility_explicit', False) if current else False
+            if state == 'present' and facility != current_facility:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % facility)
+            elif state == 'absent' and facility == current_facility and explicit:
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        if dest is None:
+            continue
+        if dest == 'host':
+            same = [item for item in have if item['dest'] == 'host' and
+                    item['name'] == entry['name'] and item.get('addr6') == entry['addr6']]
+            if entry['udp_port'] is None:
+                found = search_obj_in_list(entry['name'], same)
+                exact = same if state == 'absent' else ([found] if found else [])
+            else:
+                exact = [item for item in same if item.get('udp_port') == entry['udp_port']]
+            if state == 'absent':
+                commands.extend('no ' + _host_command(item) for item in exact)
+            elif not exact:
+                commands.extend('no ' + _host_command(item) for item in same)
+                commands.append(_host_command(entry))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = next((item for item in have if item['dest'] == 'buffered'), None)
+            active = current.get('level', set()) if current else set()
+            levels = entry['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, active)
+                commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in LEVELS if level in adds)
+            else:
+                _, removes = diff_in_list(active - levels, active)
+                commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in LEVELS if level in removes)
+        else:
+            exists = any(item['dest'] == dest for item in have)
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging %s' % dest
+            if state == 'present' and not exists:
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent' and exists:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(commands))
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTS),
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=LEVELS),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'], default='present'),
+    )
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    remove_default_spec(aggregate_spec)
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                                   fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    required_if = [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, required_if)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
